From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec asks — quick alignment before QBR

Rachel — looping you in so we can consolidate the exec asks we captured during the roadmap deep-dive. Leadership wants a single slide that explains: 1) top three product risks that could affect Q2 commitments, 2) mitigation plan and owner, and 3) any outstanding capacity/exception items that need an ask to infra.

Key bits I heard in the meeting: model latency spike on long-tail workloads, a couple of outstanding quantization regressions, and a possible Dedicated capacity shortfall for one pilot customer (ACME). Can you help pull owners and timelines? I can own the ACME coordination piece.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec asks — quick alignment before QBR

Ben — thanks. I've created a short tracker (attached) to capture the three slide buckets: Risks, Mitigations, Infra/Capacity Asks. Please do the following by EOD Weds so we have time to synthesize for Thurs leadership review: 

- Ben: confirm ACME pilot capacity timeline + any ask to sales/procurement (column: ACME timeline)
- Marissa: pull latest perf/regression numbers (p95, 99, token-cost delta) and note if quantization rollback is needed
- Vivek: add capacity exception rationale and preliminary remediation timeline (GPU pool adjustments, fallback model plan)
- Lauren: compile the final slide speaker notes and one-sentence executive summary

I've cc'd Vivek because infra exceptions will likely need a short SLA exception request. Attaching tracker: qbr_exec_asks_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet).

If anyone needs more context, I'll paste the short notes from the deep-dive below. Otherwise let's hit the deadlines above and I will consolidate.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec asks — quick alignment before QBR

Thanks Rachel — added a short note in the tracker but expanding here: 

Capacity exception detail: the ACME pilot requires a reserved Dedicated pool for predictable throughput. Current forecast shows a 3-week shortfall in Apr if we don't reallocate one node from burst capacity (impact: $Xk, mitigation: short-term reassign + automated burst policy update).

Also, we are triaging the long-tail latency spikes. Early hypothesis is that KV cache eviction at higher sequences is causing repeated re-computations; simulating a larger KV cache for a small cohort reduced the p99 by ~120ms in internal tests (see attached snippet). I'll attach a short note: capacity_exception_notes.pdf.

Will fill in remediation ETA by Tue EOD. If leadership needs an ask, I'd request permission to pre-approve a one-time node reallocation to cover ACME through pilot completion.

-Vivek
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec asks — quick alignment before QBR

Added perf numbers to the tracker (sheet: perf-summary). Short summary: quantization regression observed on model v1.9.2 for the reranking path; delta is ~2.6% on our internal eval set (recall). Proposed mitigation: rollback to v1.9.1 for reranking while we patch the quantization pipeline. Owner: Marissa (action: create rollback PR + release window).

Also note: speaker notes draft is in the drive (link below). Lauren — can you please take slide 3 (Mitigation plan + ask) and craft the one-line ask for leadership? I put a suggested sentence in column H of the tracker.

Marissa
Principal Applied ML
Redwood Inference
